messages:
miko: Heads-up: been seeing a pile of small asks post-launch. Recommend a 1-page fastpatch playbook + 48h triage rota so we stop defaulting to whoever shouts loudest. Quick sketch below. Thoughts?

andre: Love a 1-pager. Keep it surgical: who owns decision, what qualifies, and comms checklist. :white_check_mark:

sam: Question : how do we treat "small UX tweaks" reported by PMs vs customer-blockers? Want rules so PMs don't get penalized.

miko: Good point. Proposal: split by impact: customer-facing functional regressions (-> fastpatch) vs UX/QoL (-> next minor). Let PMs escalate if they can show customer blocking or SLA hit.

yasmin: Can we define the triage fields we need on the ticket? Minimal required: severity, #customers affected, reproducible?workaround, est dev effort, account owner.

miko: Exactly. Minimal template idea:```
/fastpatch request <ISSUE>
- who_reported: <name>
- severity: P1/P2/P3
- customers_impacted: <number or account list>
- repro_steps: short
- workaround: yes/no
- est_effort: <hrs/days>
- suggested_action: fastpatch/schedule
```

andre: Love the slash template. We should auto-notify account teams for P2+ in the template (e.g., @sales-team).

sam: SRE concerns: canary rollout defaults? We should have standard rollback and monitoring checklist in the playbook. @sre-bot any default suggestions?

sre-bot: Recommended defaults for fastpatch rollouts: canary 5% for 10m, 25% for 10m, 100% if no errors. Auto-rollback on error spike or latency >2x baseline. See: https://internal/runbooks/fastpatchs

yasmin: Also add acceptance criteria to the playbook: smoke tests that must pass, artifact + changelog, requester ack, and post-deploy verification steps.

miko: Agreed. Also: add a simple decision rule (one-sentence): "Fastpatch if regression/security or P2+ affecting >=3 paying customers OR no workaround and repro is clear." Everything else -> next minor.

andre: What about cost sanity check? If est_effort > 3d and impact is medium, schedule instead. Avoid huge scope creep.

sam: Ops: rotate 48h triage owner from oncall/product. Owner must respond within 48h with decision (fastpatch/schedule) and next steps. If owner unresponsive escalate to PM lead.

yasmin: Communications: if fastpatch chosen, add these steps to the ticket: notify impacted accounts, update status channel (#prod-updates), send release note to accounts after deploy.

miko: I'll draft the one-pager and the slash command payload. Plan: post handbook blurb + template link, then trial this week. Who can own rota week 1?

andre: I can take week 1 rota.

sam: I'll pair with SRE for the rollout smoke checklist.

miko: Action list: miko -> publish 1-pager + slash template; andre -> week 1 triage rota + notify sales ops; sam -> SRE smoke checklist + confirm canary defaults; yasmin -> add ticket fields to JIRA template.

andre: Fine by me. No blockers. :rocket:

miko: Cool. If anyone sees edge cases (GDPR/data-affecting, or billing impact) call it out now; otherwise I'll post the draft in #product-docs later today.

sre-bot: NOTE: linking runbook for fastpatch and post-deploy verifications: https://internal/runbooks/fastpatch-playbook
